text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day before the Satsuki Sho—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hoo, hoo, hoo——... phew.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Mm. My legs feel light. Looking good.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(...At the end of the day, their training 
regimen really suits my body, I guess.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(I just really hope they spare me anything 
annoying, though.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Alright. After this, a light breeze-up—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. Maybe I'll head over there for the 
first time in a while.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Phew......

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(It really is nice and quiet here. 
...Being alone is so calming.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(Other people... will just make fun of me 
anyway.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(A scrawny, servile runt. Without a shred 
of charm, there were a million reasons why 
it was 'okay to make fun of me.')

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(It's like this in everyday life. And in 
races too. Every single one of them 
refuses to acknowledge where I belong.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(...Whatever. Let them talk all they want. 
As much as they like.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(For every time they looked down on me, 
I'll make them look like fools in the 
stands...!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Should we head back and rest? 
Tomorrow... is a race I absolutely have to 
win, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (No... winning is the only option for me.)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
(All I have is racing... That's the only 
way to make them acknowledge me...!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A voice suddenly called out to me. 
Startled, I turned around to find—

text_block_list.name: Red-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. You're Narita Taishin, right? 
The Umamusume... who runs in races.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing there was a red-haired girl, 
about as petite as Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That's true. What about it?

text_block_list.name: Red-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, was it? You're running in 
tomorrow's G1 race, right?

text_block_list.name: Red-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Big Two'... Even though other 
Umamusume who are more physically gifted 
and appear stronger than you will be 
running."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...What are you trying to say?

text_block_list.name: Red-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
It's... nothing out of the ordinary, 
really.

text_block_list.name: Red-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
Nobody expects anything from you! Nobody 
thinks you can win!

text_block_list.name: Red-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't it just make you want to give up? 
...Normally, I mean.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Nothing in particular?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's not like I've ever run a straight and 
narrow path shouldering everyone's 
expectations anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I just want to prove everyone wrong. It's 
so twisted... you can't even call it a 
dream.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
So what if it's warped? Why the hell 
should I give up just because of that?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I will see this through. I'll make them 
acknowledge my strength. ...That is all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biting her lip, the red-haired girl ran 
off. Both of her legs were tightly wrapped 
in athletic supports...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And so, the next day.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...I will win. Absolutely.
choice_data_list:
(Her fighting spirit is even more intense 
than usual...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cloaked in a visibly blazing fighting 
spirit, Narita Taishin completed her 
preparations.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —Here I go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Tickeeet!! Show us that flashy late-charge 
again todayyy!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahideee!! I came to watch you 
win!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
—Just listen to that! Just showing herself 
brought about this massive cheer!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"All eyes are on the 'Top Two' for the 
Satsuki Sho— the head-to-head showdown 
between Winning Ticket and Biwa 
Hayahide!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Let them make as much noise as they 
want.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'll show them... every single one of 
them!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: ...Did you feel it too, Ticket?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Mm...! It gave me chills... absolute 
shivers...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"The 'Big Two'... We who are called that 
know better than anyone that it isn't 
true."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Taishin...!! I'm not gonna lose, not even 
to you!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Satsuki Sho is starting...!!
